scope: Post hoc threshold sensitivity from archived charts/scores, no simulation/fitting. Main independent-stream confirmation C1, C3 and separate F9 recording-mode effect. Secondary Validation2 C1/C2/C3 where real threshold-resolvable data are available; panel2 F9 paired recording as corroboration.
rule: Strict threshold crossing; normal FAR=max across records1:960>h. Clean40 requires max(1:160)<=h and max(161:960)>h. Clean8 uses records161:321 inclusive. No alarm-state reset at onset.
calibration_curves: Use every observed independent outer calibration order statistic from 199 normals (or259 in V2). At each rank, each frozen replicate/arm uses its own calibration threshold; then evaluate actual normal FAR and fault clean detection. Average corresponding rates across the frozen replicates.
matched_curves: For integer k permissible false alarms out of N normal evaluation runs, each arm/replicate uses its own (N-k)th ascending evaluation-normal full-run maximum, 0<=k<N; k=N uses floating-point predecessor of minimum. Count strict crossings; report achieved FAR and all ties. No fault outcomes choose thresholds. This is descriptive matching, not independent deployment calibration. No envelope, forced monotonicity, classical ROC AUC or rank interpolation.
panels: Keep V2, confirmation and recording panel2 separate. Within a panel average the frozen-replicate rates, not pseudo-independent runs. Per-horizon full grids available; plots focus on 0–15% FAR.
anchors: Nominal labels 1%,5%,10%; k=floor(n*alpha), reporting the actual attainable percentage. Tables include both models and their paired differences; original frozen operating points displayed separately.
uncertainty: 5000 paired run bootstrap replicates for matched anchors. Resample evaluation-normal and fault trajectories separately with common indices across arms and detector replicates. Re-estimate all matched thresholds in every resample; average comparison of the same frozen replicates. Pointwise, conditional on fitted monitors; legacy shared random-stream intervals descriptive only. Tied bootstrap sample may produce achieved FAR below target.
stage: Scope specified after seeing published original operating points; before computing new curves. Not externally preregistered.
